selection: mediabunny 1.66.0 (26,071,768 downloads), music-metadata 12.5.0 (9,827,896), codec-parser 2.5.0 (2,683,215), and mp3-parser 0.3.0 (40,519) are four verified JavaScript MPEG frame-header paths. Their documented local byte APIs parse both untagged controls to exact frame-aware results checked against the independent header walker; each has own JavaScript parser source coverage and stable parser-derived AFL++ feedback. None decodes Layer III audio. mpg123-decoder (2,505,430) wraps libmpg123.
uncertainty: Four verified paths; no padding. Search is six npm queries of 100 hits each, captured 2026-11-17; downloads were fetched for 15 hand-picked candidates, not every hit. mediabunny was found by `mp3 frame`, `mp3 duration` and `mp3 demuxer`, not the narrower queries. Download counts cover whole toolkits: mediabunny's muxing, conversion and many containers, and codec-parser's AAC, FLAC and Ogg parsers, not MP3 framing alone. The first three remain the highest-download fetched candidates; mp3-parser has 40,519 monthly downloads, below the duration-only leads, and is selected for its documented frame reader and exact whole-control walk. Its AFL++ differential is narrow: two source ranges in lib.js octetToBinRep bit extraction, not distinct version/channel branches. None decodes Layer III audio. The mpg123 WASM wrappers are recorded as shared-family leads. Two untagged CBR controls do not establish VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II, MPEG-2.5, CRC-protected or ID3 support. No standard Node.js MP3 API exists. codec-parser's valid-control AFL++ differential is narrow: one header-cache range that tracks distinct frame headers, not version or channel branches. Its V8 line counts include module evaluation of imported AAC, FLAC, Opus, Vorbis and Ogg files that audio/mpeg parsing does not call. music-metadata reports MPEG version and layer only through its codec string ('MPEG 1 Layer 3'), not as separate fields, and needs duration: true for a full frame walk. Its valid-control AFL++ differential is 4 sync() tail-policy ranges that track frame length, not version or channel branches. Its V8 package line count (3,539) is mostly module evaluation; MpegParser.js alone is 245 lines.
family_note: mediabunny, music-metadata, codec-parser and mp3-parser are separate parser families: different authors, repositories and frame-sync code; codec-parser 2.5.0 has no runtime dependencies. music-metadata shares its parser family with the mp3_id3v2/javascript music-metadata path (12.4.0 there, verified for ID3v2 tags); this cell verifies its MpegParser on untagged frames. Neither mediabunny nor codec-parser is among the mp3_id3v2/javascript paths.
